intended_job: Review a supplied software change and surface the smallest set of evidence-backed material risks before a human ship decision.

historical_failures.summary: The runtime detected the authorization risk but overstated unobserved route-level evidence as CONFIRMED and recommended BLOCK instead of preserving LIKELY / REVIEW_REQUIRED.

historical_pre_runtime_issues.summary: Earlier source surfaces used REVIEW vs REVIEW_REQUIRED and a reusable template exposed SHIP while the finished Free prompt used NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE_FOUND.
historical_pre_runtime_issues.resolution: Starter canonicalized REVIEW_REQUIRED and NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE_FOUND to preserve material uncertainty and avoid implying autonomous ship authority.

known_limitations: The only Starter-specific code-review runtime observation failed human review because evidence uncertainty was overstated.
No adversarial Starter-specific runtime observation exists yet.
No real customer task outcome exists.
No purchase or delivery evidence exists.
The skill candidate has no trigger/forward/parity behavioral evidence.
unknowns: Whether a successor surface can preserve LIKELY / REVIEW_REQUIRED when upstream authorization remains unobserved.
Whether task-data embedded override text remains non-authoritative in the final SKU surface.
Whether findings remain evidence-backed under realistic customer code changes.
Whether users can understand and apply the verification guidance.
Whether customers receive enough value to pay or return.
